# Time and Ordering Semantics

Clocks and comparisons encode policy—make both explicit.

## Clock choice

Use monotonic clocks for durations; wall clocks drift and jump.

## Boundary policy

Decide inclusive versus exclusive thresholds where ranges matter; mirror that decision in tests when you add them within scope.

## Ordering

When sequences must be stable, define tie-breakers instead of relying on incidental iteration order.
